findings.forcedInvention: An implementer must decide whether an account with missing or unverified age is treated as a minor, what age evidence is required, and when consent can become eligible.
findings.failureScenario: Treating unknown age as adult can expose an actual minor to scouting; treating it as minor can block consenting adults indefinitely. Both outcomes contradict the intended default-off protection.
